content: This information is not intended to serve as personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. While using this medication, it is essential to undergo laboratory and/or medical tests, such as kidney function tests. If you miss a dose of this medication, it is crucial to address it promptly. For missed injections, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to establish a new dosing schedule. If you miss an inhaled dose, use it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. For those using colistimethate as an inhalation, store unmixed vials at room temperature. Do not use premixed solutions or prepare the solution in advance, as this increases the risk of severe breathing problems. Always prepare the inhalation solution immediately before use and discard any unused solution after 24 hours. Do not store the solution for extended periods, and avoid storing it in the bathroom. Medications should not be flushed down the toilet or poured into a drain unless specifically instructed. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always seek complete information from your healthcare provider regarding this product and your health needs.
